raw_block:
#. siUBw
#: GenericCommands.xcu
msgctxt ""
"GenericCommands.xcu\n"
"..GenericCommands.UserInterface.Commands..uno:Freeline_Unfilled\n"

"value.text"
msgid "Freeform Line"
msgstr "ነፃ መስመር መፍጠሪያ"
use: Alternative freeform-line terminology in drawing UI.
limitation: Names line creation, not area selection. Do not reuse መፍጠሪያ as the selection-tool head.

msgid: <variable id="freihandtext"><ahelp hid=".uno:Freeline_Unfilled">Draws a freeform line where you drag in the current document. To end the line, release the mouse button. To draw a closed shape, release the mouse button near the starting point of the line.</ahelp></variable>
msgstr: <variable id="freihandtext"><ahelp hid=".uno:Freeline_Unfilled">እርስዎ በ መጎተት በ ነፃ መስመር መፍጠሪያ በ አሁኑ ሰነድ ውስጥ መሳል ይችላሉ: መስመሩን ለ መጨረስ: ይልቀቁ የ አይጥ መጠቆሚያውን: የ ተከበበ ቅርጽ ለ መፍጠር: የ አይጥ ቁልፉን ይልቀቁ በ መስመሩ መጀመሪያ አጠገብ </ahelp></variable>
raw_block:
#. oBGHD
#: 01140000.xhp
msgctxt ""
"01140000.xhp\n"
"par_id3154163\n"
"help.text"
msgid "<variable id=\"freihandtext\"><ahelp hid=\".uno:Freeline_Unfilled\">Draws a freeform line where you drag in the current document. To end the line, release the mouse button. To draw a closed shape, release the mouse button near the starting point of the line.</ahelp></variable>"
msgstr "<variable id=\"freihandtext\"><ahelp hid=\".uno:Freeline_Unfilled\">እርስዎ በ መጎተት በ ነፃ መስመር መፍጠሪያ በ አሁኑ ሰነድ ውስጥ መሳል ይችላሉ: መስመሩን ለ መጨረስ: ይልቀቁ የ አይጥ መጠቆሚያውን: የ ተከበበ ቅርጽ ለ መፍጠር: የ አይጥ ቁልፉን ይልቀቁ በ መስመሩ መጀመሪያ አጠገብ </ahelp></variable>"
use: Supports the freehand trace sense of freeform, not no-cost/free software.
limitation: Source describes drawing a line and closing near start; AN-Paint closes a selection-mask path. This is lexical/contextual analogy, not shared behavior or acceptance.

"..GenericCommands.UserInterface.Commands..uno:FillColor\n"
"Label\n"
"value.text"
msgid "Fill Color"
msgstr "ቀለም መሙያ"
use: Exact candidate character sequence ቀለም መሙያ is attested as a drawing UI label.
limitation: The source is Fill Color, not Bucket Fill. It supports colour-filling vocabulary but does not attest connected-region flood filling or the bucket metaphor.

use: Exact short caption for image-colour sampling control, nearest direct tool-metaphor precedent.
limitation: Its parent dialog replaces colours; only the pipette sampling step is analogous. Does not establish idiomatic preference or AN-Paint foreground behavior.

msgid: Select one of the four source color boxes. Move the mouse pointer over the selected image, and then click the color that you want to replace.
msgstr: ይምረጡ አንዱን ከ አራቱ የ ቀለም ምንጮች ሳጥን ውስጥ: የ እይጥ መጠቆሚያውን በ ተመረጠው ምስል ላይ ያድርጉ: እና ከዛ ይጫኑ እርስዎ መቀየር የሚፈልጉትን ቀለም
raw_block:
#. CQGvD
#: svx/uiconfig/ui/dockingcolorreplace.ui:508
msgctxt "dockingcolorreplace|extended_tip|pipette"
msgid "Select one of the four source color boxes. Move the mouse pointer over the selected image, and then click the color that you want to replace."
msgstr "ይምረጡ አንዱን ከ አራቱ የ ቀለም ምንጮች ሳጥን ውስጥ: የ እይጥ መጠቆሚያውን በ ተመረጠው ምስል ላይ ያድርጉ: እና ከዛ ይጫኑ እርስዎ መቀየር የሚፈልጉትን ቀለም "
use: Confirms that cited Pipette samples a clicked colour from an image, not a physical medical instrument or generic palette chooser.
limitation: The sampled colour populates replacement source-colour selection, not foreground. No functional equivalence beyond sampling is claimed.

raw_block:
#. eBWRW
#: svx/uiconfig/ui/floatingcontour.ui:429
msgctxt "floatingcontour|TBI_PIPETTE"
msgid "Pipette"
msgstr "ጠብታ መለኪያ"
use: Corroborates spelling of Pipette caption in a second UI context.
limitation: This context selects bitmap parts of a matching colour. It is not additional evidence for AN-Paint sampling behavior.

msgid: Selects the parts of the bitmap that are the same color. Click here, and then click a color in the bitmap. To increase the color range that is selected, increase the value in the Tolerance box.
msgstr: የ ቢትማፕስ አካል መምረጫ ተመሳሳይ ቀለም ያላቸውን: እዚህ ይጫኑ: እና ከዛ ይጫኑ የ ቢትማፕስ ቀለም: የ ተመረጠውን ቀለም መጠን ለማስፋት: ዋጋውን መጨመሪያ በ  ገደብ  ሳጥን
raw_block:
#. A6v7a
#: svx/uiconfig/ui/floatingcontour.ui:433
msgctxt "floatingcontour|extended_tip|TBI_PIPETTE"
msgid "Selects the parts of the bitmap that are the same color. Click here, and then click a color in the bitmap. To increase the color range that is selected, increase the value in the Tolerance box."
msgstr "የ ቢትማፕስ አካል መምረጫ ተመሳሳይ ቀለም ያላቸውን: እዚህ ይጫኑ: እና ከዛ ይጫኑ የ ቢትማፕስ ቀለም: የ ተመረጠውን ቀለም መጠን ለማስፋት: ዋጋውን መጨመሪያ በ  ገደብ  ሳጥን "
use: Keeps the second Pipette context transparent and attests መምረጫ in bitmap-area selection prose.
limitation: Same-colour area selection is not eyedropper foreground sampling, freeform selection, or rectangle selection.
